name: Eroge Kaisha no Kindan no Sekuhara Jijou ~Nerawareta Shinjin Illustrator~
original_name: エロゲ会社の禁断のセクハラ事情～狙われた新人イラストレーター～
source:
Iwasaki Azusa left her small town with high hopes of finding a job in Tokyo, but her job hunt was a bust... so she ended up working part-time at a family restaurant.

One day, she happened to find her beloved game maker recruiting illustrators on the internet. After a remote interview, she landed a job at an eroge company.

The day of her first visit to the company arrived, but the "company" turned out to be just a room in the president's personal apartment. Azusa felt uncomfortable as the president looked her over with a clingy gaze. However, she was thrilled to have gotten a job at the company she admired.

Little did she know... it was the beginning of a nightmare.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1278452]Getchu[/url]]

Fun fact: the game is a homage to a sexual harassment scandal in a [url=https://vndb.org/p739]certain[/url] company.
